title: Sub-Zero — Brand Guide
intro: Brand overview, customer profile, and selling angles for Sub-Zero.

sections.title: Brand Story
sections.content: Tagline: "The Living Kitchen." Luxury tier. Sub-Zero invented the built-in refrigerator in 1945 and has been the benchmark ever since. Their dual compressor system keeps the freezer and fridge on separate sealed systems — freezer air never touches fresh food. The air purification system, inspired by NASA technology, scrubs ethylene gas, bacteria, and viruses. Sub-Zero, Wolf, and Cove are all made in the same Madison, Wisconsin factory.

sections.title: The Right Customer
sections.content: Luxury kitchen builds, architect-specified projects, customers who want food to last longer. The "gold standard" reference point for built-in refrigeration.

sections.title: Selling Angles
sections.content:
Key selling angles for Sub-Zero:

• Dual compressor — completely separate systems for fridge and freezer, food stays fresher 2x longer

• NASA-inspired air purification scrubs ethylene gas so produce lasts weeks, not days

• Built-in design integrates flush with cabinetry — refrigerator disappears into the kitchen

• Made in Madison, Wisconsin — not outsourced, every unit hand-tested

• Factory service network with technicians trained exclusively on Sub-Zero/Wolf/Cove
